scope: Focused publication tests, public diagnostic aggregates, new-package integrity/privacy, current reading links and unchanged historical snapshots; not the full research software suite.

commands.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_dissertation_revision.py tests/test_dissertation_publication.py

figure_review: All points and axis labels visible after export; panels A and B include full [0,1] AUC range.
whitespace_check: Includes staged and unstaged changes against HEAD. CRLF line endings in generated CSV evidence are preserved and accepted; other whitespace checks remain enabled.
